title: Set up your tracking
subtitle: Optionally tell us which substances you want to follow. Tracking is voluntary — you can skip this and add or change it later from your account.
privacyNote: You do not need to share your consumption history to use Soma. Educational pages stay available either way.
editSubtitle: Update which substances you follow. Changes replace your current tracking list when you save.
editPrivacyNote: Saving with no substances selected removes configured tracking after confirmation. Continuing without tracking leaves existing rows unchanged.

mode.abstinentDescription: We'll use your last-use date to estimate recovery over time.
mode.activeDescription: We'll show impact estimates without assuming you've stopped.

skipHint: Leaves any existing tracking unchanged. You can set this up later.
loadError: Could not load your profile. Check your connection and try again.
loadErrorHint: We will not change your tracking until the profile loads successfully.
clearConfirmBody: Saving with no substances selected will delete the tracking you already configured. This cannot be undone from this screen.

errors.saveFailed: Could not save your tracking. Try again.
errors.statusFailed: Your substances were saved, but we could not update your onboarding status. Retry without losing your data.
errors.skipFailed: Could not continue without tracking. Try again.
errors.consentRequired: To save tracking, first allow Soma to keep those data.
